svg.title: Stuffing: Dressmaker's tissue pattern
svg.desc: Stuffing (1D): your toy body laid open flat as a dressmaker's tissue pattern, six pieces for head, chest, two arms and two legs, each with its hollows for memories. Embroidered memory patches fill some hollows; the empty ones glow warm, because the hunger lives there. A patch named "Lila's hum" is being dragged from the tray at the bottom into the chest, and the margin shows the hunger rate this packing will give.
svg.text: needs a warm slot in HEAD
TRAY: unpacked memories unravel when you close
PATTERN No. 6 · ONE BODY, SIX SEAMS
